vocabulary.definition: additional people or things that are brought to help
vocabulary.example: The army sent reinforcements to support the troops in battle.

vocabulary.definition: next to or adjoining something else
vocabulary.example: The two houses were adjacent to each other, sharing a common wall.

vocabulary.definition: to move to a new place
vocabulary.example: Due to the company's expansion, employees had to relocate to the new office.

vocabulary.definition: trapped in a place or situation from which it is hard to escape
vocabulary.example: The thief was cornered by the police in the alley and had nowhere to run.

vocabulary.definition: reasoning from general principles to specific cases
vocabulary.example: Sherlock Holmes used deductive reasoning to solve the mysterious case.
